items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Well, I heard Freddie Webster play "Stardust," and I really didn't want to play "Stardust" no more after I heard that

ctx.x: Talking about trumpet players in that time, what do you remember about Freddie Webster?

Well, I heard Freddie Webster play "Stardust," and I really didn't want to play "Stardust" no more after I heard that -- just to let you know what I thought about how he was playing. But I really didn't want to play "Stardust" no more after I heard him play it. Butt I had to, because I had played it first, which got out there before his solo did -- and everybody was giving me credit for playing "Stardust." But Freddie Webster was the man that really played "Stardust." I don't take nothing away from Freddie…
